All-Star Football 🏈 
Step into gridiron park and play real football with your friends!



🏈 Play 2v2 or 3v3 games to 24
🏆 Compete in full 7v7 games featuring kickoffs, quarters, and 2-point tries
📈 Climb to 99 OVR by earning XP, leveling up your rating, and unlocking rewards
👥 Start a clan, represent your tag, and build your record
🎮 Keyboard, controller, and mobile supported

🔥 Latest Update 🔥
• New halloween season pass
• Limited time Halloween bundles
• New Crates
• Play now and park improvements
• And much more!

❗OPEN ALPHA ACCESS ❗
Expect bugs, balance changes, and new updates as we continue building!

❌ Report bugs or share suggestions in our Communications Server!
👍 Like the game and join the group for a free reward!
🔔 Follow for updates and new drops!
💚 Redeem codes for free Allstar coins and wheel spins, check our communications server!
